description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ahri''' blows forth a kiss in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit, [[File:Knockdown icon.png|20px|link=Knockdown|An icon representing the keyword Knockdown]] [[:Knockdown|knocking them down]] and [[File:Charm icon.png|20px|link=Charm|An icon representing the keyword Charm]] [[:Charm|charming]] and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them by 65% for a duration.
